articles.summary: Press release: Owens-Brockway Glass Container Inc. Launches $500 Million Senior Notes Offering
articles.title: Owens-Brockway Glass Container Inc. Launches $500 Million Senior Notes Offering

articles.summary: O-I Glass, Inc. (the “Company”) announced that Owens-Brockway Glass Container Inc. (“OBGC”), an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, priced a private offering (the “Offering”) of $500 million aggregate principal amount of its 9.500% senior notes due 2033 (the “Notes”) at par.
articles.title: Owens-Brockway Glass Container Inc. Announces Pricing of Senior Notes Offering
